description:
The cassowary is often called the most terrifying bird alive, and every reason in this video is real: a boom so low you may feel it before you hear it, a helmet that turns out to be a radiator, a dad who barely eats for fifty days, a bird that swims, sprints, and may have been raised by people 18,000 years ago, and the claw on its inner toe. Doug meets every one of them.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad decision.
